[NCBK.6.8] Errors via the pending slot: NULL cb →
`DS_ERR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE`; a NaN `Float` argument →
`DS_ERR_NAN_REJECTED`, and nothing is issued ([IDSP.6.3]); a non-OK callback
result propagates verbatim.

A kwarg whose value is `null` prevents the call ([LNUL.11.1]): the engine emits
no `ACTION_CALL`, invokes no callback and reports no status, the firing's other
actions run, and `ds.calls.arg_error_total{service}` counts it ([NMET.4.1]).

A call's arity and argument types are the compiler's guarantee, so no status
reports them. A call whose operands its op does not admit is an `EngineError`
`ENGINE_FAULT_ARTEFACT_LIED`, and the tier halts ([RDSC.4a.9.3]).
